description:
Cast Fleshbag Marauder by paying {2}{B}.
When Fleshbag Marauder enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Fleshbag Marauder and each other player to sacrifice a creature.
When Fleshbag Marauder dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Fleshbag Marauder from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.
